categories_thin: Title and settlement agencies: none found with a Highland Park address (nearest are in New Brunswick/Cranford); likely a genuine zero.
Staffing agencies: only one (GoWork); most nearby staffing firms are in New Brunswick.
Appraisers and property-title work: nothing found in-borough beyond Midlantic Property Management and Preferred Properties.
Security/alarm installers: only two dated directory records; the category is dominated by regional firms that serve but are not located in the borough.

Plumbing/electrical/HVAC/landscaping: most results were 'serves Highland Park' contractor-marketplace pages (Angi/HomeAdvisor) with no borough address. Only firms with a real borough address were kept, so this category is undercounted relative to the true number of home-based licensed contractors in town.
Optometry/medical specialists: mostly individual physicians listed only in insurance directories; only practices with a clear borough office were included.
Hotels/lodging: none in the borough (nearest are in New Brunswick).
Furniture/appliance/music-instrument retail: no dedicated stores found beyond the shops listed; Highland Park's retail strip is small and food-heavy.
caveats: Zone is the Borough of Highland Park only (about 1.3 sq mi); the entire borough sits roughly 6-7 miles from central Milltown, so nothing in this zone falls outside the 10-mile radius.
The Highland Park Chamber of Commerce site (business.chamberhp.com) turned out to be Highland Park, ILLINOIS - it was discarded and is not a source here.
YellowPages, SuperPages, BBB, Cylex, Opendi and Angi block automated fetching; BBB and YellowPages data here comes from search-result snippets only and should be re-verified.

RE/MAX Best Realty (42 Woodbridge Ave) and Century 21 J.J. Laufer (309 Raritan Ave) were found but excluded as franchise-brand offices, along with franchised Kumon, Arthur Murray, Minuteman Press, MaidPro and MobilityWorks locations and branded gas stations/banks.

Supermarkets, pharmacies, liquor stores, restaurants and food retail found in the sources were excluded per the brief (SuperFresh, Glatt 27, Careza Pharmacy, Unite Pharmacy, Park Liquor, Fresh Mart, wine and liquor store, etc.).

Several trade contractors (Eleven Exterior, Highland Park Plumbing & Heating, Crown Home Remodeling, Salacki Painting, 4 Star Construction) publish home or home-office addresses; these are their published business addresses from directories, not personal details.
Cannabis retailers ANJA and BLKBRN are included as independent non-food retailers and flagged as borderline.
Where a business appeared under two names at one address (The Loft Salon/Park Salon; Zen Dental/Dr. Yan Min Gu; ArchAuto/Kam Soon; FBN Auto at two nearby addresses) they were merged into one entry.
data_gaps: Overpass/OpenStreetMap API was unreachable from this environment (fetch failed, alternate endpoint timed out), so no OSM completeness cross-check was possible.
The borough website (hpboro.com) returned HTTP 403 to fetching, and the borough has no public business-directory page that could be read.
The Highland Park NJ chamber/main-street organization does not publish a public member directory online (Main Street Highland Park site shows events only).
Google Maps in this browser only rendered a 5-result 'limited view' per query, so it could not be used for exhaustive per-category sweeps.
No public list of borough-licensed businesses (mercantile licenses) was accessible.
Phone numbers and websites are blank/'Unknown' where the source did not publish them; the triage team will need to look these up.

Home-based licensed contractors (electricians, plumbers, landscapers, cleaners) are systematically under-represented because directories only list them by service area rather than a Highland Park address.
